stance_rationale: The draft fails the alpha robustness gates it reports itself: subperiod_stability=0.0409 versus 0.50 and DSR=0.344 versus 0.50. It also relies on inherited Iter 5 provenance and expected optimizer effects while required WT-011 challenge, lineage, weights, covariance, and qepm/stage artifacts are missing.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_011/alpha_scores.parquet is multi-date and monthly, but the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_011 alpha_scores path and WT-011 weights.csv are missing; schedule usage remains unverified.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN detected; package specifies Z_Score_Aligned fields.
Current WT-011 artifact has no Usable_Date proof; C14 is asserted as inherited from Iter 5 rather than enforced in this run.
WT-011 factor_engine_proposal.R reads Iter 5 alpha_scores.parquet directly; no load_month_factors() call or WT-011 equivalence proof is present.
dd_lag and vol_lag use shift(..., n=1L); regime_state remains inherited and needs downstream verification.
Quarterly 45d and annual May lags are declared in factor_specs, but not revalidated in WT-011 due inherited parquet reuse.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A1 is active: sub_stability=0.0409 is far below 0.50, DSR=0.344 is below 0.50, P3 IC collapses to 0.0025, and CRISIS IC is -0.1727. AX-001 conditional defense cannot be claimed when bad-regime IC is negative.

Composite ICIR=0.3442 is below inherited Core ICIR=0.4162, so the added defense sleeve has not proven incremental alpha value at signal level. The package relies on diversification and optimizer effects, but L-119 warns static blends can dilute alpha and L-484 only permits score-level blending, not untested performance inheritance.

The selected candidate is justified with expected_sr='1.5+ aspirational' and 'expected to inherit' Iter 5 FF5 results, but Kelly+Overlay portfolio returns are not re-tested here and reported DSR fails. This is multiple-testing and component-stacking inflation unless Forge/FF5/DSR are rerun on the actual WT-011 portfolio.

WT-011 does not rebuild factors through load_month_factors() and does not expose Usable_Date checks; it copies Iter 5 alpha_scores then truncates. Inherited PIT claims are not equivalent to current-run enforcement.

The package claims challenge_note.md records the Codex round, but WT-011 contains no challenge_note.md and no artifact_lineage.json. This violates No Silent Override and prevents AX-008 triangulation.

alpha_scores itself is multi-date, but WT-011 weights.csv is missing, so there is no evidence that optimizer/backtest uses the full Date x Ticker score panel instead of the single latest alpha_vector.

Top-decile liquidity cannot be verified from WT-011 alpha_scores because TV/AvgTV20 is absent; the request uses a 50m liquidity floor while base hard constraint is 2e8 KRW. Computed decile monotonicity is about 0.667, below the 0.80 alpha gate.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_011 has 69,715 rows, 239 signal dates, 773 tickers, and monthly spacing from 2004-01-01 to 2023-11-01.
last signal date is before 2026-04-25, so no future signal date was detected in the available alpha_scores artifact.
rank_IC, ICIR, and Harvey t pass the numeric gates, but they are not sufficient because DSR and subperiod stability fail.
No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern was found in WT-011 source files.
C9 dd_lag and vol_lag are explicitly lagged with shift(..., n=1L).
